responsibility: This implementation module provides the REAL math wrappers for GNU Modula-2 by combining GCC builtin mappings for operations like sqrt, sin, and cos with libm calls for exp, tan, atan, logarithms, and floor-based integer extraction. Although it also contains sibling precision variants internally, its stable role is to back the exported REAL elementary-math interface of MathLib0, complementary to LMathLib0 for LONGREAL.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation half of the MathLib0 pair: it supplies the REAL routines with cbuiltin/libm calls and also includes internal SHORTREAL and LONGREAL helper procedures such as sqrts/sqrtl and arctans/arctanl. Unlike gcc/m2/gm2-libs/MathLib0.def, it is not just the exported interface.
